paragraphs.text: The Great Desert is a vast wasteland on the western subcontinent of Jamuura on the plane of Dominaria .
It lies east of the Ekundu and Jotoka Mountains , and north of Arboria and the Blue Mountains .

The Great Desert is home to such creatures as viashino and dragons after they left Shiv . It is mostly controlled by Suq’Ata , and home of such legendary figures as Hivis of the Scale and Zirilan of the Claw .
